integrity: The lower bound is proved from an exact decomposition of every centered increasing support into positive centered-threshold vectors. The upper endpoint is included as prior context and follows from the standard projection/Cauchy--Schwarz argument. Exact-rational computation replays the identities and boundary constructions but is not used as a universal proof.
scientific_limitations: The lower endpoint is profile-specific and is an unattained infimum when the prescribed profile has at least three distinct atoms.
The theorem concerns iid maxima and finite discrete support.
The complete 1998 upper-bound article was not available for full-text inspection, leaving a bounded originality risk for any unobserved lower-bound remark.
title: Exact lower endpoint and full fixed-profile range for expected maxima
